jobs.title: Mortgage Loan Processor
jobs.description_html:
At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As a Mortgage Loan Processor in our Melbourne Headquarters, you’ll help guide approved first mortgage loans from application through closing. You’ll review loan files for completeness and accuracy, coordinate required documentation, support borrowers and business partners, and help ensure timely, compliant closings that exceed member expectations.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Hybrid and Flexible Schedule Options: Able to work from home up to 3 days a week. 2 days in office required.   
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

 Mortgage Loan Processor Key Responsibilities

  • Review and process conventional, FHA, VA, and other first mortgage loan applications for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with lending guidelines.
  • Verify borrower income, assets, employment, credit history, and funds to close; ensure approval conditions are satisfied before closing.
  • Order and review appraisals, title commitments, flood certifications, and other third-party documentation within established timelines.
  • Submit complete loan files to underwriting, follow up promptly on conditions, and manage a pipeline of approximately 20–40 loans in line with department goals.
  • Communicate clearly with borrowers, Realtors, closing agents, and internal partners regarding documentation, file status, and closing arrangements while maintaining confidentiality.
  • Resolve member questions and file issues efficiently while meeting established productivity, loan quality, regulatory, attendance, and service standards.

Mortgage Loan Processor Requirements

  • Two-year degree or equivalent experience required.
  • 3–5 years of mortgage processing, mortgage closing, or banking experience related to review and process of mortgage applications required.
    • Mortgage closing or mortgage processing experience preferred.
  • Familiarity with TRID and investor guidelines, including Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, and VA, preferred.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain active NMLS registration before performing mortgage loan originator activities, when applicable.

 Mortgage Loan Processor Compensation

[Salary range not visible to internal publishing.]

  • Starting Salary: $28.13 – $29-79
  • Bonus Opportunity: Eligible for 4%ONE SCCU Annual Bonus.

 SCCU Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus an Employee Assistance Program.
  • Financial Perks: 401(k) match (5%), HSA match, and SCCU-paid insurance (short/long-term disability, life insurance).
  • Education Support: Tuition reimbursement after one year of service.
  • Generous Time Off: 20+ days of PTO, birthday PTO, and 11 federal holidays.
  • Exclusive Discounts: Lower rates on loans, credit cards, and no fee SCCU accounts!

Work Schedule

  • Monday – Friday 8:00am – 5:00pm

About SCCU

Since 1951, Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU) has proudly served our community, growing to over 685,000 members and managing $9 billion in assets. With 67 branches spanning Florida’s east coast, we are the third-largest credit union in the state. In 2025, we expanded into Orange County to better serve the growing East Orlando market.

As a not-for-profit financial institution, SCCU is dedicated to putting our members first. Unlike traditional banks, we return profits to our members through better rates, lower fees, and enhanced services. While we offer the same financial products—like checking, savings, and loans—our focus remains on empowering our members and supporting their financial well-being. With local decision-making and a commitment to exceptional service, we strive to make a meaningful difference in the lives of those we serve.

At SCCU, we also prioritize our team members by fostering a supportive and collaborative environment that encourages career growth and development. As we continue to grow, we are seeking talented, member-focused professionals to join our team and help deliver innovative financial solutions and outstanding service.

 I UNDERSTAND this application a legal document for purposes of your employment.  Upon acceptance of an offer with SCCU, I UNDERSTAND that I will be required to complete background, employment verifications, and drug screening.  I UNDERSTAND further that any misstatements or omissions in this application and pre-employment process can be considered falsification and will result in a decision not to hire me, or to discharge me if discovered after I am hired. I UNDERSTAND that the information requested regarding date of birth, race and sex is for the sole purpose of gathering the above information accurately, and will not be used to discriminate against me in violation of any law. jobs.description_html:
At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As a Process Engineer III, you will supports the continued growth and development of SCCU. The Business Process Engineer will collaborate with stakeholders throughout the enterprise to craft process improvements, optimizations, and automations that deliver improved business performance as well as improved learner and Team Member experience. The Business Process Engineer will serve as a change champion, driving adoption of Lean Six Sigma, identifying and implementing transformational operating models, and creating better connections between our people, processes, and technologies. The Business Process Engineer will lead group initiatives that encompass research and future state requiring application of specialized knowledge or skills critical to the design and redesign of SSCU business processes.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Flexible Schedule Options
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

Process Engineer III Key Responsibilities

  • Execute end to end process improvement efforts by using Six Sigma/LEAN methodology and Business Process Modeling to conduct current state process analysis, build future state vision and formulate actionable improvement opportunities by partnering with cross-functional teams.
  • Integrate effective change management and training techniques to drive enhanced standardization and alignment across SCCU.
  • Analyzing and interpreting data using statistical techniques to support re-engineering objectives
    Designing and building future state processes and tools to enable scalable and flexible operations by creating new processes or improve existing flow across functional teams making it clearly documented and actionable.
  • Utilizes key Lean Six Sigma and Operational Excellence principles to identify opportunities, define and justify projects, launch project teams, manage team activities, track project status, measure results, remove project barriers and develop/train team members.
  • Motivates and directs cross functional teams in applying Lean Six Sigma and continuous improvement methodologies, planning and implementing product and process improvement activities. Documents key work streams and processes with the appropriate maps, policies, procedures, work instructions, etc. Gains are sustained and replicated across the business. Supports business personnel activities to eliminate ‘waste’, reduce costs and increase throughput to enable growth.
  • Improves internal and external member experience by building continuous improvement foundation on which SCCU’s businesses can perform and grow.
  • Increases team member awareness of processes and tools to deliver better products, services, and experiences for our customers. Drives Lean Six Sigma principles, tools and applications throughout company creating a culture that shares best practices and learns from mistakes.
  • Works with management to identify challenge areas and key gaps within organization for process improvement/ waste reduction projects thus building a robust pipeline. Continually challenges the status quo in support of Growth Initiatives.
  • Establish standards for measuring performance against process requirements utilizing formal process engineering tools and methods
  • Ensure development of metrics that provide data for future improvement opportunities
  • Strong product knowledge and a good grasp with an understanding of member expectations and quality of products.

Process Engineer III Requirements

  • Bachelors Degree preferably in a Business or Technical discipline and Lean/Six Sigma Black Belt (DMAIC, DFSS or equivalent) required. Professional certifications such as Business Process Professional (CBPP) and Change Management Professional (CMP) preferred.
  • 8-10 years of Process Engineering experience required, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education.

Process Engineer II Compensation

$113,900.00 - $120,628.00

SCCU Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus an Employee Assistance Program.
  • Financial Perks: 401(k) match (5%), HSA match, and SCCU-paid insurance (short/long-term disability, life insurance).
  • Education Support: Tuition reimbursement after one year of service.
  • Generous Time Off: 20+ days of PTO, birthday PTO, and 11 federal holidays.
  • Exclusive Discounts: Lower rates on loans, credit cards, and no fee SCCU accounts!

Work Schedule

  • Monday – Friday: 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.

 Since 1951, Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU) has proudly served our community, growing to over 685,000 members and managing $9 billion in assets. As a not-for-profit financial institution, SCCU is dedicated to putting our members first. Unlike traditional banks, we return profits to our members through better rates, lower fees, and enhanced services. While we offer the same financial products—like checking, savings, and loans—our focus remains on empowering our members and supporting their financial well-being. With local decision-making and a commitment to exceptional service, we strive to make a meaningful difference in the lives of those we serve.

At SCCU, we also prioritize our team members by fostering a supportive and collaborative environment that encourages career growth and development. As we continue to grow, we are seeking talented, member-focused professionals to join our team and help deliver innovative financial solutions and outstanding service.

jobs.title: Business Services Advisor
jobs.description_html:
At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As the Business Service Advisor at our Miramar Operations Center, you will be responsible for driving business growth by identifying, developing, and expanding relationships with prospective and existing business members. This role serves as a consultative partner to members by assessing needs, recommending appropriate products and services, and delivering solutions that support member goals and business objectives. The position requires a strong sales mindset, effective business development skills, the ability to manage a pipeline of opportunities, and a high level of personal accountability for sales activity and follow-through. The role also requires strategic thinking, sound judgment, strong organizational and time-management skills, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively in support of overall member satisfaction and revenue growth.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Hybrid & Flexible Schedule Options
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

Business Service Advisor Responsibilities

  • Identify, develop, and maintain relationships with prospective and existing business members to support growth in business deposits, loans, and related services.
  • Understand members’ needs and recommend appropriate business products and services that align with their financial goals and operational needs.
  • Generate new business opportunities through proactive outreach, networking, relationship development, referrals, and community engagement.
  • Build, manage, and maintain a consistent sales pipeline by prospecting, conducting follow-up, tracking opportunities, and advancing relationships through the sales process.
  • Meet or exceed established sales goals, performance expectations, and key performance indicators, including production, relationship growth, activity levels, and member experience standards.
  • Prepare and deliver business development presentations, product recommendations, and proposals in a professional and member-focused manner.

Business Service Advisor Requirements

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in sales, business development, outside sales, relationship management, financial services sales, or a comparable member-facing business development role required.
  • Experience building, managing, and maintaining a sales pipeline, including prospecting, outbound outreach, follow-up, and opportunity tracking, required.
  • Experience in banking, credit union, treasury services, business lending support, merchant services, or other financial services environments preferred.
  • Experience using CRM tools to document activity, manage follow-up, maintain pipeline visibility, and support reporting preferred.
  • Must complete the Association of Accredited Small Business Consultants Simplified Examination within 60 days of employment.
  • Two-year College or University diploma (Associate’s) in Business Administration, Finance/Accounting or equivalent experience required. 
  • Valid Florida Driver’s license and good driving record required with a working vehicle.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish fluency preferred.
  • The selected candidate will be responsible for supporting the Broward and Palm Beach service territory.

Business Service Advisor Compensation

At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As the Manager, Credit Reporting in our Melbourne Headquarters Credit Reporting department, you’ll oversee the accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance of consumer credit data furnished to credit reporting agencies. You’ll lead a team of specialists, set strategic direction for credit reporting operations, manage quality control routines, and serve as a subject matter expert for FCRA, FACTA, Metro 2® standards, and credit reporting best practices.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Hybrid and Flexible Schedule Options: This position is Hybrid with 2 days per week required in office
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

Manager, Credit Reporting Key Responsibilities

  • Own and govern the end-to-end credit bureau reporting lifecycle, including data sourcing, file creation, validation, transmission, reconciliation, and post-submission monitoring.
  • Ensure timely and accurate credit data reporting in compliance with Metro 2® specifications, FCRA/FACTA requirements, CFPB guidance, and bureau-specific rules.
  • Oversee consumer dispute investigations and resolutions, including e-OSCAR processes, regulatory timelines, quality standards, and escalation of material reporting issues.
  • Design, monitor, and improve quality control routines, audits, reconciliations, exception reporting, and corrective action plans to support data accuracy and compliance.
  • Partner with Compliance, Legal, Risk, IT, Lending, vendors, and credit bureaus to resolve issues, support audits and regulatory exams, and strengthen reporting controls.
  • Lead process improvement initiatives, automate reporting and dispute workflows, track KPIs, provide executive-level insights, and mentor a high-performing team.

 Manager, Credit Reporting Requirements

  • Two-year degree or equivalent industry experience required.
  • FCRA Certification required within one year in the position.
  • 3-5 years of experience in credit reporting or a related industry required.
  • Minimum of one year of prior supervisory or management experience required.
  • Deep expertise in Metro 2®, FCRA, FACTA, CFPB expectations, and consumer dispute handling required.

  • Starting Salary: $86,720 - $91,836

  • Communicate effectively in person, by phone, and in writing, expressing ideas clearly and concisely while adhering to established member service standards.
  • Adapt effectively to changing environments by adjusting work style and priorities, responding quickly to new situations, and reorganizing tasks to address urgent needs.
  • Demonstrating strong self-motivation and independent problem-solving skills with minimal supervision, to maximize productivity, efficiency, and member satisfaction; recommend process improvements to enhance efficiency and outcomes.

  • Adapt effectively to changing environments by adjusting work style and priorities, responding quickly to new situations, and reorganizing tasks to address urgent needs.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer II - Endpoint
jobs.description_html:
At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

This position is a 6 month contract-to-hire.

As a Systems Engineer II, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and securing the enterprise workstation and mobile endpoint estate, including Windows, macOS, and iOS devices managed through Microsoft Intune. This role owns operating system and third-party application patching, OS lifecycle management, software packaging and deployment, Group Policy (GPO) and Intune policy administration, configuration baselines, and endpoint security tooling across on-premises, cloud-managed, and remote endpoints in a regulated financial services environment.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Flexible Schedule Options
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

Systems Engineer II Key Responsibilities

  • Administer, maintain, and optimize Tanium as the primary endpoint management and patching platform, including module configuration (Patch, Deploy, Comply, Asset, Interact), sensor/package authoring, content distribution, and operational reporting.
  • Design, execute, and continuously improve enterprise patching strategies for Windows and macOS operating systems and third-party applications, including monthly Patch Tuesday cycles, out-of-band releases, zero-day remediation, and Windows feature update servicing.
  • Coordinate patch testing, pilot rings, phased production deployment, validation, and rollback procedures across on-site and remote/VPN workstations; monitor patch compliance dashboards and remediate failures or non-reporting devices promptly.
  • Package, test, and deploy enterprise applications for Windows (MSI, EXE, MSIX, Win32), macOS (PKG, DMG), and iOS (App Store and line-of-business apps) using Tanium Deploy and Microsoft Intune (with SCCM/MECM where applicable); maintain a curated software catalog and self-service application access.
  • Manage endpoint provisioning and enrollment workflows for Windows (Autopilot), macOS (Automated Device Enrollment via Apple Business Manager / Intune), and iOS (ADE via ABM / Intune), including driver libraries, in-place feature upgrades, and zero-touch provisioning experiences.
  • Own the full lifecycle of Group Policy Objects (GPOs) and Microsoft Intune policies for endpoints across Windows, macOS, and iOS. This includes configuration profiles, compliance policies, security baselines, endpoint protection policies, app configuration and protection policies, update rings, and conditional access. Design policies, test in pilot rings, deploy to production, troubleshoot, document, and continuously tune them to align with CIS-based hardening standards and business requirements.
  • Develop and maintain automation for endpoint provisioning, software deployment, patch orchestration, health checks, and reporting using Tanium sensors/packages, PowerShell, Python, and Bash/shell scripting for macOS.
  • Manage workstation lifecycle activities including provisioning, refresh, decommissioning, asset reconciliation, and timely retirement of unsupported operating systems and applications.
  • Partner with the Cybersecurity team to analyze vulnerability scan results (e.g., Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7), prioritize remediation based on risk and exploitability, and track remediation to closure within defined SLAs.
  • Provide Tier 3 escalation support for complex endpoint, software deployment, OSD, patch compliance, and client health issues; perform root cause analysis and drive permanent remediation.
  • Participate in platform upgrades and migrations (e.g., Tanium module rollouts, Windows 10 to 11, macOS major version transitions, Intune co-management and cloud-native moves) while following established operational, risk, and change control processes.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, standards, procedures, and change records to support operational consistency, audit readiness, and knowledge transfer to peers and the service desk.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, network, identity, cloud, and application teams to support secure, resilient, and high-performing endpoint services; other duties as assigned.

Systems Engineer II Requirements

5 to 8 years of progressively responsible endpoint engineering experience in enterprise environments, including strong hands-on administration of Tanium for endpoint management and patching, Microsoft Intune for Windows/macOS/iOS, Group Policy (GPO) and Intune policy administration and deployment, third-party application patching, software packaging, scripting (PowerShell), and Tier 3 troubleshooting. Experience with SCCM/MECM, Kaseya VSA, or similar platforms is a plus.

A 4-year degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent combinations of education, certifications, and directly related enterprise endpoint engineering experience will also be considered. Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or government is strongly preferred.

Systems Engineer II Compensation

$113,900.00 - $120,628.00

SCCU Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus an Employee Assistance Program.
  • Financial Perks: 401(k) match (5%), HSA match, and SCCU-paid insurance (short/long-term disability, life insurance).
  • Education Support: Tuition reimbursement after one year of service.
  • Generous Time Off: 20+ days of PTO, birthday PTO, and 11 federal holidays.
  • Exclusive Discounts: Lower rates on loans, credit cards, and no fee SCCU accounts!

Work Schedule

  • Monday – Friday: 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.
  • This role requires flexibility for after hours and weekend work, as needed, to perform changes and maintenance without impacting business operations.

 Since 1951, Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU) has proudly served our community, growing to over 685,000 members and managing $9 billion in assets. As a Systems Engineer II, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and securing enterprise Linux platforms with a primary focus on Red Hat Enterprise Linux, while also supporting distributions such as Ubuntu and related Linux variants. This role supports highly available, secure, and well-controlled infrastructure that underpins critical business services in a regulated financial services environment across on-premises, virtual, and cloud-hosted platforms.

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.

  • Administer, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise Linux servers with primary responsibility for Red Hat Enterprise Linux and supporting knowledge of Ubuntu and other Linux distributions.
  • Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and harden Linux operating systems, core services, and supporting packages across development, test, and production environments.
  • Manage system performance, availability, capacity, and operational health through monitoring, tuning, log analysis, and proactive maintenance.
  • Implement and maintain security controls including user and group administration, file permissions, SSH, sudo, PAM, SELinux, firewall configuration, certificate updates, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Execute compliance and hardening activities using SCAP, STIG, CIS benchmarks, and NIST-aligned controls; document findings, remediation plans, exceptions, and operational evidence for audits and reviews.
  • Support Linux workloads hosted on virtualized, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure, including integration with VMware, storage, backup, monitoring, networking, and identity platforms.

  • Provide advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis for infrastructure incidents impacting operating system, middleware, application, storage, network, or security services.
  • Support backup, recovery, business continuity, and disaster recovery planning and testing for Linux-based systems and services.

 5 to 8 years of progressively responsible Linux systems administration experience in enterprise environments, including strong hands-on administration of Red Hat Enterprise Linux, server patching, troubleshooting, security hardening, scripting, and support of virtualized infrastructure.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer II - Endpoint
jobs.description_html:
At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

This position is a 6 month contract-to-hire.

As a Systems Engineer II, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and securing the enterprise workstation and mobile endpoint estate, including Windows, macOS, and iOS devices managed through Microsoft Intune. This role owns operating system and third-party application patching, OS lifecycle management, software packaging and deployment, Group Policy (GPO) and Intune policy administration, configuration baselines, and endpoint security tooling across on-premises, cloud-managed, and remote endpoints in a regulated financial services environment.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Flexible Schedule Options
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

Systems Engineer II Key Responsibilities

  • Administer, maintain, and optimize Tanium as the primary endpoint management and patching platform, including module configuration (Patch, Deploy, Comply, Asset, Interact), sensor/package authoring, content distribution, and operational reporting.
  • Design, execute, and continuously improve enterprise patching strategies for Windows and macOS operating systems and third-party applications, including monthly Patch Tuesday cycles, out-of-band releases, zero-day remediation, and Windows feature update servicing.
  • Coordinate patch testing, pilot rings, phased production deployment, validation, and rollback procedures across on-site and remote/VPN workstations; monitor patch compliance dashboards and remediate failures or non-reporting devices promptly.
  • Package, test, and deploy enterprise applications for Windows (MSI, EXE, MSIX, Win32), macOS (PKG, DMG), and iOS (App Store and line-of-business apps) using Tanium Deploy and Microsoft Intune (with SCCM/MECM where applicable); maintain a curated software catalog and self-service application access.
  • Manage endpoint provisioning and enrollment workflows for Windows (Autopilot), macOS (Automated Device Enrollment via Apple Business Manager / Intune), and iOS (ADE via ABM / Intune), including driver libraries, in-place feature upgrades, and zero-touch provisioning experiences.
  • Own the full lifecycle of Group Policy Objects (GPOs) and Microsoft Intune policies for endpoints across Windows, macOS, and iOS. This includes configuration profiles, compliance policies, security baselines, endpoint protection policies, app configuration and protection policies, update rings, and conditional access. Design policies, test in pilot rings, deploy to production, troubleshoot, document, and continuously tune them to align with CIS-based hardening standards and business requirements.
  • Develop and maintain automation for endpoint provisioning, software deployment, patch orchestration, health checks, and reporting using Tanium sensors/packages, PowerShell, Python, and Bash/shell scripting for macOS.
  • Manage workstation lifecycle activities including provisioning, refresh, decommissioning, asset reconciliation, and timely retirement of unsupported operating systems and applications.
  • Partner with the Cybersecurity team to analyze vulnerability scan results (e.g., Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7), prioritize remediation based on risk and exploitability, and track remediation to closure within defined SLAs.
  • Provide Tier 3 escalation support for complex endpoint, software deployment, OSD, patch compliance, and client health issues; perform root cause analysis and drive permanent remediation.
  • Participate in platform upgrades and migrations (e.g., Tanium module rollouts, Windows 10 to 11, macOS major version transitions, Intune co-management and cloud-native moves) while following established operational, risk, and change control processes.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, standards, procedures, and change records to support operational consistency, audit readiness, and knowledge transfer to peers and the service desk.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, network, identity, cloud, and application teams to support secure, resilient, and high-performing endpoint services; other duties as assigned.

Systems Engineer II Requirements

5 to 8 years of progressively responsible endpoint engineering experience in enterprise environments, including strong hands-on administration of Tanium for endpoint management and patching, Microsoft Intune for Windows/macOS/iOS, Group Policy (GPO) and Intune policy administration and deployment, third-party application patching, software packaging, scripting (PowerShell), and Tier 3 troubleshooting. Experience with SCCM/MECM, Kaseya VSA, or similar platforms is a plus.

A 4-year degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent combinations of education, certifications, and directly related enterprise endpoint engineering experience will also be considered. Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or government is strongly preferred.

Systems Engineer II Compensation

$113,900.00 - $120,628.00

SCCU Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus an Employee Assistance Program.
  • Financial Perks: 401(k) match (5%), HSA match, and SCCU-paid insurance (short/long-term disability, life insurance).
  • Education Support: Tuition reimbursement after one year of service.
  • Generous Time Off: 20+ days of PTO, birthday PTO, and 11 federal holidays.
  • Exclusive Discounts: Lower rates on loans, credit cards, and no fee SCCU accounts!

Work Schedule

  • Monday – Friday: 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.
  • This role requires flexibility for after hours and weekend work, as needed, to perform changes and maintenance without impacting business operations.

  • Perform threat hunting and advanced detection activities to protect systems and data.
  • Lead the planning, testing, and scheduling of system patches across all endpoints, mobile devices, servers, and network infrastructure.
  • Develop and maintain a patch management schedule and ensure timely application of security patches and updates.

  • Work closely with network, systems, and application teams to ensure security is integrated into the infrastructure. Support secure system and application development practices.
  • Assist in delivering cybersecurity training programs to staff, promoting awareness of security policies, phishing attacks, and safe computing practices.

jobs.description_html:
At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As a Compliance Specialist I -Fair Lending in our Melbourne Headquarters, you’ll will be responsible for implementing the Credit Union’s Fair Lending Compliance Risk Management Program.  The Fair Lending Compliance Specialist will serve as a liaison to business units across the three lines of defense to identify and mitigate Fair Lending risk.

Why Join SCCU?

• Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
• Hybrid and Flexible Schedule Options: Available for select positions. This position is Hybrid with 2 days per week required in office.
• Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Analyze lending data with extensive use of Microsoft Excel, utilizing Consumer, Mortgage and Business lending data from applicable internal lending operating systems.
  • Monitor all lending processes and procedures to proactively identify emerging Fair Lending risks and report findings to management.
  • Maintain accurate records of lending data reviews and outcomes and prepare regular reports summarizing activity and trends for management review.
  • Provide guidance and support to lending business units regarding procedures and regulatory obligations.
  • Assist business units with reporting and assessing enterprise-wide Fair Lending compliance, including assessing compliance risk management programs as well as targeted regulations and requirements, such as: Fair Lending, Home Mortgage Disclosure Act, Unfair Deceptive or Abusive Acts or Practices, and the technical federal and state regulatory laws, rules, and regulations applicable to the Credit Union’s lending functions.
  • Participate in proposed changes to policies, procedures, and Credit Union training to ensure Fair Lending compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
  • Maintain relationships and effective communication with business units across the Credit Union to influence strong Fair Lending compliance standards and consideration of Fair Lending risk.
  • Assist in the design and/or revision of lending related forms, disclosures, notices, Marketing advertisements and promotions to ensure compliance with applicable rules and regulations.
  • Review and analyze formal complaints and Member surveys according to applicable focus, to identify potential Fair Lending concerns, trends, and areas for improvement as part of SCCU’s Complaint Management Program.
  • Collaborate with business units to investigate Fair Lending complaints, determine root causes, and recommend corrective actions to mitigate compliance risk.

Minimum Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.  The requirements listed below are representative of the minimum level of knowledge, skills and/or ability required.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and Training:

High School Diploma or GED is required.  A combination of training, education, and experience is preferred.  Credit union or banking compliance and/or Fair Lending experience preferred.

 Prior Experience:

1-3 years’ of regulatory compliance knowledge in at least one of the following areas:  Fair Lending, HMDA, and UDAAP.  Minimum 1 year experience in SCCU Training, Mortgage and/or Consumer Lending, Underwriting, Processing, Servicing, or Loss Prevention Department may be considered as equivalent experience. 

Preferred Skills:

  • Working knowledge of the following applications:
  • Encompass and/or Meridian Link loan operating systems.
  • Excel, Word, PowerPoint applications.

Compliance Specialist I: Compensation

• Starting Compensation: $51,450-$54,505 annually
• Bonus Opportunity: Eligible for ONE SCCU Annual Bonus.


SCCU Benefits

• Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus an Employee Assistance Program.
• Financial Perks: 401(k) match (5%), HSA match, and SCCU-paid insurance (short/long-term disability, life insurance).
• Education Support: Tuition reimbursement after one year of service.
• Generous Time Off: 20+ days of PTO, birthday PTO, and 11 federal holidays.
• Exclusive Discounts: Lower rates on loans, credit cards, and no fee SCCU accounts!


Work Schedule

• Monday – Friday: 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.

jobs.title: Teller/Customer Service - Sunrise Town Center Branch
jobs.description_html:
At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As a Member Service Specialist (Teller/Customer Service) in our Sunrise Town Center Branch, you will deliver exceptional service by assisting members with deposits, loans, and new account processing. You will assess member needs, provide tailored recommendations for SCCU products, and resolve any issues efficiently.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Flexible Schedule Options
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.
  • Member Service Specialist positions are eligible for a promotion at 12 months.

Member Service Specialist Key Responsibilities

  • Consistently demonstrates effective sales and service skills by meeting established goals.
  • Consults with members regarding SCCU products and services and recommends additional offerings to meet member needs.
  • Periodically serves as floor manager to assess walk-in member’s needs. Directs them to the appropriate information source while ensuring maximum lobby efficiency, and minimizing member waiting time.
  • Performs all aspects of transactions, including deposits, withdrawals, payments, and the sale of monetary instruments to provide complete member service.
  • Balances cash, monetary instruments, and daily work accurately to ensure member account integrity.
  • Services existing deposit and loan accounts, assists members with transactions and account maintenance to meet and exceed their expectations.
  • Masters and effectively utilizes the computer terminal and online system, and all required commands, including general ledger fee and transaction codes, to produce error-free work.

Member Service Specialist Requirements

  • 6+ months of customer service and/or cash handling experience preferred. 
  • High School Diploma or equivalency

Member Service Specialist Compensation

  • Starting Salary: $17.91 - $18.97/hour
  • Bonus Opportunity: Eligible for ONE SCCU Annual Bonus.

SCCU Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus an Employee Assistance Program.

Full Time during Branch hours of operation:

Monday - Friday 8:00 am- 6:00 pm.

jobs.title: Building Engineer- North Broward and Palm Beach / Indian River Counties
jobs.description_html:
At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As a Building Engineer in our [Miramar Operations Center you will be responsible for maintaining, operating, and troubleshooting building systems.  Your role will focus on performing routine maintenance tasks, responding to service requests, and ensuring systems operate safely.  This role will focus on Servicing Branch Locations in North Broward, Palm Beach, and Indian River Counties.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

 

Building Engineer Key Responsibilities

  • Perform scheduled maintenance, repairs, and inspections of building systems; address service requests, including hot/cold calls, plumbing issues, and lighting repairs.
  • Troubleshoot minor equipment malfunctions and escalate issues as needed.
  • Replace light fixtures/bulbs, filters, and other components as required.
  • Maintain accurate records of inspections and equipment performance.
  • Interact with occupants, contractors, and facilities managers and work closely with facilities management leadership to support smooth building operations and resolve location issues.
  • Assist with preventive maintenance tasks and contractor oversight.
  • Conduct property inspections to identify deficiencies.
  • Record equipment readings and ensure assigned building systems are operating according to standards.
  • Follow company safety protocols and wear appropriate PPE; ensure compliance with OSHA, NEC, NFC, NFPA regulations; report safety hazards; participate in safety inspections.
  • Provide guidance to junior Technicians when needed.
  • Communicate verbally and in writing with teammates, leadership team, and vendors in a professional manner, keeping the appropriate customer(s) informed/updated as needed.
  • Work closely with senior management to develop technical skills and participate in professional development programs.

 

Building Engineer Requirements

  • HS Diploma or GED required
  • A valid Universal level EPA Section 608 certification is required.
  • A valid Florida driver’s license with and an acceptable driving record is required
  • Minimum of four (4) years of technical experience in all aspects of building engineering with a strong background in technical aspects of HVAC equipment and systems, plumbing, electrical, equipment repair and maintenance, and overall system design and application.
  • 3-5 years of job-related experience or commensurate certification/trade experience.

 

Job Title Compensation 

  • Starting Salary: $32.04 - $33.93 per/hour depending on experience.
  • Bonus Opportunity: Eligible for a 4% ONE SCCU Annual Bonus.

 

SCCU Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus an Employee Assistance Program.
  • Financial Perks: 401(k) match (5%), HSA match, and SCCU-paid insurance (short/long-term disability, life insurance).
  • Education Support: Tuition reimbursement after one year of service.
  • Generous Time Off: 20+ days of PTO, birthday PTO, and 11 federal holidays.
  • Exclusive Discounts: Lower rates on loans, credit cards, and no fee SCCU accounts!

Work Schedule

  • Monday – Friday: 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.
  • Occasional Saturdays & On Call as needed

Unlike traditional banks, we return profits to our members through better rates, lower fees, and enhanced services. While we offer the same financial products—like checking, savings, and loans—our focus remains on empowering our members and supporting their financial well-being. This position is a 6 month contract-to-hire. 

The ServiceNow Developer will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining ServiceNow solutions that support Space Coast Credit Union’s IT and business processes. This individual will be responsible for configuring and customizing ServiceNow applications, implementing workflows, and integrating the platform with other enterprise systems. The developer will work closely with stakeholders to understand requirements, troubleshoot issues, and deliver high-quality solutions that enhance operational efficiency and user experience. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong technical skills, a collaborative mindset, and a commitment to continuous improvement within the ServiceNow environment.

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Flexible Schedule Options

  •  Own the development of the enterprise platform ecosystem, using ServiceNow to standardize intake, workflow orchestration, CMDB alignment, and cross-platform integrations that enable end-to-end visibility and consistent service delivery.
  • Develop, configure, and customize ServiceNow applications and modules to meet business requirements.
  • Implement and maintain workflows, business rules, UI policies, and client scripts within the ServiceNow platform.
  • Collaborate with IT and business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Integrate ServiceNow with other enterprise systems using REST, SOAP, and other APIs.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to ServiceNow functionality, performance, and integrations.
  • Participate in testing, deployment, and documentation of ServiceNow solutions.
  • Maintain data integrity and ensure compliance with organizational standards and best practices.
  • Assist in upgrading ServiceNow instances and applying patches as needed.
  • Provide technical support and training to end users and junior developers.
  • Stay current with ServiceNow releases and new features, recommending improvements to enhance platform capabilities.

jobs.description_html:
At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As a Manager of Network Engineering, you will be responsible for leading the Information Technology Network Engineering function by ensuring secure, reliable, and highly available network infrastructure, connectivity, performance, and operational support across the organization while enabling business continuity, scalability, and exceptional end-user experience.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Flexible Schedule Options
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

Manager, Network Engineering key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for managing network operations, engineering strategy, and service reliability in a 24x7 operating environment.
  • Plans, coordinates, directs, and designs operational activities of the IT Network Engineering team, including LAN, WAN, wireless, firewall, VPN, cloud connectivity, and network services.
  • Responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining industry best practices to secure network infrastructure, perimeter defenses, segmentation, and remote access capabilities across the organization.
  • Continually develops strategies, standards, and procedures to maintain secure network defenses against unauthorized access to internal, external, branch, data center, cloud, and remote connectivity environments.
  • Oversee network architecture and technical designs that provide high levels of availability, performance, redundancy, and security while complying with enterprise architecture standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
  • Works closely with IT leadership, security, infrastructure, application, and business stakeholders to identify, recommend, implement, and support cost-effective network technology solutions.
  • Serves as primary point of contact and liaison between IT Network Engineering, Information Security, Infrastructure, Operations, and business technology teams.
  • Manages all the deliverables to ensure adherence to deadlines, specifications, and budgets.
  • Manage relationships with telecom carriers, internet service providers, network vendors, and managed service providers to ensure operational excellence and reliable connectivity.
  • Implements network performance metrics, availability reporting, capacity planning, SLA monitoring, and periodic reporting for leadership.
  • Monitors and tracks project progress and reports findings to leadership.
  • Ensures staff keeps current with technological developments within the industry.
  • Provide after-hours support for network maintenance, upgrades, patching, incident response, outage resolution, and change implementation.

Manager, Network Engineering Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or other relevant degree or equivalent experience is required. 
  • 8-10 years of Network Engineering experience, including 3-5 years of Management experience in a technical role required.

Manager, Network Engineering Compensation

$153,830.00 - $162,917.00

SCCU Benefits

  • Financial Perks: 401(k) match (5%), HSA match, and SCCU-paid insurance (short/long-term disability, life insurance).

The Advanced Service Technician at Nextran Truck Centers is a skilled position that is responsible for repairing and maintaining our customer’s Medium & Heavy-Duty Trucks. This includes diagnosing issues, preventative maintenance, repairs, disassembly and re-assembly, and writing detailed work notes.

Essential Duties

Technical

  • Maintain proficiency in the diagnosis and repair of all assigned equipment.
  • Maintain proficiency in the rebuilding of major components on assigned equipment.
  • Ensure accurate diagnosis and the effective repair and/or replacement of components necessary for the proper functioning of assigned equipment.
  • Perform Service calls for emergency breakdowns.

Administrative

  • Interact effectively, courteously, professionally with customers, vendors, and other employees regarding vehicle repairs and other shop business.
  • Reports machinery defects or malfunctions to supervisor.
  • Communicates with parts department to obtain needed parts.
  • Saves and tags parts of the job if under warranty or if requested by the customer.
  • Examines assigned vehicle to determine if further safety or service work is required or recommended.
  • Communicates with service advisor/dispatcher immediately on repair updates and or delays.
  • Documents all work performed and recommended on the repair order.
  • Supervises work of any apprentice technicians as assigned.

Health, and Safety

  • Reports machinery defects or malfunctions to supervisor.
  • Ensures that vehicle is kept clean. Notifies service advisor/dispatcher immediately of anything that has happened to change the appearance or condition of the vehicle.
  • Maintains and is accountable for all dealership-owned tools and manuals. Returns them to the proper place and in the same condition as when they were received.
  • Understands, keeps abreast of, and complies with federal, state, and local regulations, such as hazardous waste disposal, OSHA Right-to-Know, etc. Keeps abreast of manufacturer technical bulletins.
  • Operates all tools/equipment in a safe manner and reports any safety issues immediately to management.
  • Make building and facility repairs as requested.
  • Perform other maintenance duties or assignments as requested.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Two to four years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • ASE Certification a plus
  • Cummins Engine Repair Certification a plus
  • Basic computer skills
  • High School Diploma- College or Technical training preferred, but not required
  • Valid CDL License a plus, recommended within 1 year of hiring.

Nextran Core Hiring Competencies

  • Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions
  • Instills Trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity
  • Communicates Effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences
  • Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm
  • Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward

Notice Regarding Job Posting Scams

We are aware that fraudulent job postings and recruitment scams are becoming more common. Please be advised that legitimate communications from our company will only come from official company email addresses and through our verified hiring platforms.

We will never ask candidates to provide payment, purchase equipment, or share sensitive personal or financial information (such as bank account details or Social Security numbers) during the initial application or interview process.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to represent our company, please do not respond or provide any information. Instead, report the communication to us through our official website or apply directly through our verified job postings.

Your safety and privacy are important to us, and we encourage all applicants to remain vigilant when searching for employment opportunities.

We are a network of commercial truck dealerships committed to providing the best products and services through highly skilled associates who are focused on delivering the lowest life-cycle cost to our customers. Spanning the Southeast and Midwest United States, we provide sales, parts, and service for several leading brands, including Mack, Volvo, Isuzu, GMC, Ford, Hino, and Kalmar Ottawa. EEO Employer

Are you looking to further develop your profession into a career? Are you driven by opportunity? Nextran Truck Centers is hiring! Our Employees Benefit from:

Great Medical, Dental, & Vision Benefits || Social Responsibility Opportunities || 28+ Years of Industry Experience || Professional Growth

The Service Technician at Nextran Truck Centers is a skilled position that is responsible for repairing and maintaining our customers’ Medium & Heavy-Duty Trucks. This includes preventative maintenance, repairs, disassembly, and reassembly, and writing detailed work notes.

Essential Duties:

Performs work as outlined on the repair order with efficiency and accuracy, in accordance with dealership and factory standards.
  • Diagnose the cause of the malfunctions and perform repairs.
  • Communicates with the parts department to obtain needed parts.
  • Saves and tags parts of the job if under warranty or if requested by the customer.
  • Documents all work performed and recommended on the repair order.
  • Reports machinery defects or malfunctions to the supervisor.
  • Ensures that the vehicle is kept clean. Notifies the service advisor/dispatcher immediately of anything that has happened to change the appearance or condition of the vehicle.
  • Maintains and is accountable for all dealership-owned tools and manuals. Returns all tools and manuals to the proper place and in the same condition as when they were received.
  • Understands, keeps abreast of, and complies with federal, state, and local regulations, such as hazardous waste disposal, OSHA Right-to-Know, etc. Keeps abreast of manufacturer technical bulletins.
  • Operates all tools/equipment in a safe manner and reports any safety issues immediately to management.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Skills and Qualifications:

  • Two plus years of diesel mechanic experience.
  • ASE or Cummins Engine Repair Certificate is a plus.
  • English proficiency is essential for understanding safety protocols, customer interactions, and internal communications.
  • Basic computer skills
  • Valid CDL License a plus, recommended within 1 year of hiring.

Mathematical Skills:

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, percentage, draw and interpret bar graphs.

Reasoning Ability:

Ability to solve problems and deal with a variety of variables in situations with only limited resources.Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is:

  • Regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms.
  • Use of torque wrenches, air powered tools or hand tools.
  • Use of arms in a raised position above shoulder level for prolong periods of time. Use of creeper or rolling device to enable tech to work underneath vehicle.
  • The employee frequently is required to walk; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear.
  • The employee is required to stand and sit for extended periods of time (hours) while making repairs.
  • Entry or exit from the cab of the vehicle.
  • Climb to a safe position to access the engine compartment area, firewall or roof of a vehicle to perform repairs.
  • The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 100 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move more than 100 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Ability to push/pull large tool chest from vehicle to vehicle.

Work Environment:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

  • Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions
  • Instills Trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity
  • Communicates Effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences
  • Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm
  • Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward

Summary

The Service Technician at Nextran Truck Centers is a skilled position that is responsible for repairing and maintaining our customer’s Medium & Heavy-Duty Trucks. This includes preventative maintenance, repairs, disassembly and reassembly, and writing detailed work notes.

Essential Duties

  • Performs work as outlined on repair order with efficiency and accuracy, in accordance with dealership and factory standards.

  • Communicates with the parts department to obtain needed parts.

  • Saves and tags parts of the job if under warranty or if requested by the customer.

  • Documents all work performed and recommended on the repair order.

  • Reports machinery defects or malfunctions to the supervisor.

  • Ensures that the vehicle is kept clean. Notifies service advisor/dispatcher immediately of anything that has happened to change the appearance or condition of the vehicle.

  • Maintains and is accountable for all dealership-owned tools and manuals. Return them to the proper place and in the same condition as when they were received.

  • Understands, keeps abreast of, and complies with federal, state, and local regulations, such as hazardous waste disposal, OSHA Right-to-Know, etc. Keeps abreast of manufacturer technical bulletins.

  • Operates all tools/equipment in a safe manner and reports any safety issues immediately to management.

Skills and Qualifications

  • High School Diploma

  • Basic computer skills

  • Up to Two years related experience and/or training as a Technician.

  • Valid CDL License a plus, recommended within 1 year of hiring.

Mathematical Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.

Reasoning Ability

Ability to solve problems and deal with a variety of variables in situations with only limited resources. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms.

  • Use of torque wrenches, air powered tools or hand tools.

  • Use of arms in a raised position above shoulder level for prolong periods of time. Use of creeper or rolling device to enable tech to work underneath vehicle.

  • The employee frequently is required to walk; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear.

  • The employee is required to stand and sit for extended periods of time (hours) while making repairs.

  • Entry or exit from the cab of the vehicle.

  • Climb to a safe position to access the engine compartment area, firewall or roof of a vehicle to perform repairs.

  • The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 100 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move more than 100 pounds.

  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

  • Ability to push/pull large tool chest from vehicle to vehicle.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

Essential duties and related qualifications may be changed as needed to meet the changing demands of the organization. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.   • Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm
  • Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward

Nextran Truck Centers Diesel Technician - Tallahassee, FL

Are you looking to further develop your profession into a career? Are you driven by opportunity?

Nextran Truck Centers is hiring!

Job Duties

The Diesel Technician is a skilled position that is responsible for repairing and maintaining our customers Medium & Heavy-Duty Trucks. This includes diagnosing issues, preventative maintenance, repairs, disassembly and re-assembly, and writing detailed work notes.

  • Diagnoses cause of malfunctions and performs repairs.
  • Performs work outlined on repair order efficiently and accurately.
  • Communicates with parts department to obtain needed parts.
  • Communicates with Service Advisor on repair updates and/or delays.
  • Documents all work performed and recommended on the repair order.
  • Understands, keeps abreast and complies with federal, state and local regulations, such as hazardous waste disposal, OSHA, etc.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Heavy-duty truck repair experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Personal tools. Basic Hand Tools
  • ASE Certification a plus
  • Experience with Mack, Volvo, Isuzu, Cummins heavy-duty trucks and engines.
  • Basic computer skills
  • Valid CDL a plus

Physical Demands

  • Regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms.
  • Use of torque wrenches, air powered tools and hand tools.
  • Use of arms in a raised position above shoulder level for prolonged periods of time.
  • Frequently required to walk, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, talk and hear.
  • Entry and exit safely in and out of truck cab.
  • Regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 100 pounds, and occasionally life and/or move more than 100 pounds.

jobs.description_html:
Nextran Truck Centers Mobile Diesel Mechanic - Orlando, Florida

Join a team that brings the shop to the customer. Are you an experienced diesel technician looking for something different? Do you enjoy building relationships, solving problems, and working directly with customers rather than spending every day in the same service bay?

Nextran Truck Centers is hiring! Our Employees Benefit from:

Career Paths || Network of 30 Dealerships || Disability Insurance || Paid Time Off (2wks 1st year) || Nextran Paid Life Insurance

Family Centered Values || Medical and Dependent Care FSA || 401(k) Retirement Plan with Match || Company-Paid Holidays || EAP

Great Medical, Dental, & Vision Benefits || Social Responsibility Opportunities || 28+ Years of Industry Experience || Professional Growth

Summary

As a Mobile Diesel Technician, you will serve as a concierge-style field technician supporting customer fleets on-site. You become an extension of both our dealership and our customers’ operation. Every day brings new challenges and opportunities as you work closely with fleet managers, drivers, and maintenance personnel to keep equipment operating safely and efficiently.

This is not a traditional roadside emergency repair position. Instead, you will serve as a trusted technical resource for our fleet customers, delivering planned maintenance, inspections, upgrades, and repair solutions directly at their locations.

We believe our technicians are among our most valuable assets. In this role, you will not simply repair equipment, you will build lasting relationships with customers and help develop solutions that support their business. You will work directly on customer property, in their maintenance facilities, and in the field, serving as a trusted advisor and representative of our organization.

Essential Duties:

  • Scheduled preventive maintenance services
  • Factory warranty campaigns and recalls
  • Fleet-wide upgrades and retrofits
  • DOT inspections and certifications
  • Windshield replacements
  • Valve adjustments and engine services
  • Diagnostic troubleshooting and repairs
  • Customer consultations and maintenance planning
  • Coordinating transportation of equipment to our dealership service center when major repairs are required.

What We’re Looking For

  • Heavy-duty diesel repair experience
  • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills
  • Excellent communication and customer service abilities
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently
  • Professional appearance and positive attitude
  • Commitment to safety and quality workmanship
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and customer needs

Schedule

This position offers variety and flexibility. Work schedules may vary based on customer requirements and business needs. We strive to accommodate the needs of our team members while maintaining the flexibility necessary to deliver exceptional customer service.

What We Offer

  • Competitive starting pay
  • Performance-based wage growth opportunities
  • Additional compensation opportunities tied to industry certifications
  • Company-provided service truck stocked with tools and inventory
  • Potential authorization to take company vehicle home based on performance and business needs
  • Ongoing training and professional development
  • Supportive team environment
  • Opportunity to build meaningful customer relationships and make a direct impact

Why Join Us?

If you’re looking for a career where your skills, work ethic, professionalism, and positive attitude are genuinely appreciated, you’ve come to the right place. Join a team that values expertise, invests in its people, and empowers technicians to make a difference every day.

Nextran Core Hiring Competencies:

  • Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions
  • Instills Trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity
  • Communicates Effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences
  • Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm
  • Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward

Notice Regarding Job Posting Scams

We are aware that fraudulent job postings and recruitment scams are becoming more common. Please be advised that legitimate communications from our company will only come from official company email addresses and through our verified hiring platforms.

We will never ask candidates to provide payment, purchase equipment, or share sensitive personal or financial information (such as bank account details or Social Security numbers) during the initial application or interview process.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to represent our company, please do not respond or provide any information. Instead, report the communication to us through our official website or apply directly through our verified job postings.

Your safety and privacy are important to us, and we encourage all applicants to remain vigilant when searching for employment opportunities.

The Counter Part Sales is responsible for selling parts to all customers over the counter, through the shop, or on the phone in a friendly and efficient manner.

Essential Duties

  • Assist all customers (retail and shop) in selecting required parts in a friendly, professional, and efficient manner.
  • Answer phone calls, providing price quotes and other information.
  • Provide and high level of service to internal and external customers.
  • Pull and fill orders from stock.
  • Locate out-of-Stock parts from outside sources and submit emergency orders as needed.
  • Follow up on Back ordered parts.
  • Replenishes assigned inventory.
  • Assists Outside Sales Representatives with their orders.
  • Makes sure all internal requests for parts are billed on service repair orders.
  • Receive payment from retail customers or obtain credit authorization.
  • Ensure that all charge sales are signed by the customer.
  • Ensure that all customers receive their copy of the invoice.
  • Issue credit for parts returned, ensuring that the original invoice, or its number is available so that purchase and pricing can be verified.
  • Make over the counter and telephone sales, invoice customers, and take payments.
  • Assist customers in part selection, provide technical information, and advice.
  • Suggest possible add-on items as appropriate.
  • Promote sales by telephone, mail, and email.
  • Keep counter areas clean and uncluttered.
  • Other duties, as assigned.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 1 year of experience in parts counter sales, or an Associates degree and 1 year of experience in the industry.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Computer proficiency
  • High School Diploma

Summary:
The Receptionist/Cashier is primarily responsible for accurately processing customer payments, handling cash and credit card transactions, and supporting parts dealership processes. This position also serves as the first point of contact for customers by providing professional reception services, answering phones, directing inquiries, and assisting with administrative duties to ensure smooth daily operations and an exceptional customer experience.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Greets customers warmly and professionally upon arrival and ensures a positive customer experience.
  • Answers incoming telephone calls, responds to inquiries, and directs calls to the appropriate department or team member.
  • Accurately receives, processes, and reconciles cash, check, credit card, and other customer payments in accordance with company procedures.
  • Scans, files, and maintains invoices and other dealership records.
  • Processes customer payments and assists with invoice and related documentation.
  • Maintains a clean, organized, and professional reception area.
  • Supports daily administrative operations and provides general clerical assistance.
  • Performs other duties assigned.

Skills & Qualifications:

  • 1–2 years of receptionist or customer service experience (automotive industry a plus)
  • Strong basic math and cash-handling skills, with the ability to accurately process payments, make changes, reconcile receipts, and perform basic calculations.
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office
  • Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • Professional demeanor and customer-first attitude

Physical Demands:

  • Sitting/Standing: Ability to remain seated for extended periods while working at a computer or answering phones. Occasional standing and walking are required to assist customers or retrieve documents.
  • Manual Dexterity: Frequent use of hands and fingers for typing, writing, handling paperwork, and operating office equipment (e.g., phone, printer, scanner, payments).
  • Lifting/Carrying: Occasionally lift and carry items up to 20 pounds, such as office supplies, small packages, or promotional materials.
  • Reaching/Bending: Regular reaching at or below shoulder level to access files, supplies, or equipment. Occasional bending or stooping to retrieve items from lower drawers or cabinets.
  • Vision/Hearing: Must be able to read printed materials and computer screens and hear and respond to customer inquiries in person and over the phone.

Essential duties and related qualifications may be changed as needed to meet the changing demands of the organization. Nextran Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and a Drug Free Workplace.

  • Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm
  • Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward

jobs.description_html:
Nextran Truck Centers - Jacksonville Shipping & Receiving Coordinator Are you looking to further develop your profession into a career? Are you driven by opportunity? Nextran Truck Centers is hiring!

The Shipping & Receiving Coordinator ensures accurate and timely processing of incoming and outgoing shipments, maintaining inventory accuracy and leads to achieve departmental goals in a fast-paced warehouse environment.

Essential Duties include:

  • Coordinates all shipping and receiving activities, including scheduling, labeling, packing and inspecting shipments.

  • Ensures compliance with company policies, safety standards and shipping regulations.

  • Monitors and maintains inventory control systems, resolving discrepancies as needed.

  • Communicates with carriers, suppliers and internal department to resolve issues and improve efficiency.

  • Maintains accurate records of shipments, receipts and returned goods.

  • Operates warehouse equipment (e.g. forklift, pallet jack, etc.) as necessary.

  • Ensures warehouse is always neat and clutter free.

  • Other duties as assigned.

Preferred Candidates have the following:

  • Two year related/relevant experience
  • High school diploma or equivalent. Associate degree or certification in logistics a plus
  • Some automotive and/or heavy-duty truck parts experience preferred
  • Excellent organizational, leadership and communication skills
  • Ability to work flexible hours including weekends
  • Strong mathematical and analytical skills
  • Computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office (Word, Excel)
