jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.description_html:
Nextran Truck Centers Talent Acquisition Partner - Central Florida Region

Nextran Truck Centers is seeking an experienced Talent Acquisition Partner to help build the workforce that will support our continued growth. Based at our Orlando Florida dealership, this position will initially support talent acquisition efforts across the Central Florida Region, and will report to the corporate Vice President of Human Resources.

This Talent Acquisition Partner goes beyond filling open positions. This individual will work closely with dealership and HR leadership to understand current and future talent needs, build sustainable candidate pipelines, strengthen bench strength, and improve hiring and retention outcomes.

As a new role within Nextran, this position offers the opportunity to help shape and expand our talent acquisition strategy across the organization.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with dealership leaders to identify current and future hiring needs and gaps in bench strength.
  • Develop short- and long-term recruiting strategies that support both external hiring and internal talent development.
  • Source, recruit, screen, and help select qualified candidates for skilled trade, operational, sales, leadership, and other dealership positions.
  • Build proactive candidate pipelines for critical and difficult-to-fill roles.
  • Manage the recruiting and hiring process in partnership with Hiring Managers and local HR.
  • Help leaders improve interviewing, candidate assessment, and selection practices.
  • Support the identification and development of high-potential employees for future opportunities.
  • Partner with management on effective onboarding and training plans for new hires and monitor early retention.
  • Develop relationships with technical schools, industry organizations, professional associations, and other talent sources.
  • Leverage recruiting technology, social media, career fairs, marketing, and other creative sourcing strategies.
  • Monitor the competitive talent market and recommend ways for Nextran to remain competitive in attracting and retaining employees.
  • Use recruiting data and analytics to track results, including time-to-fill, source of hire, hiring volume, 90-day retention, and bench strength progress.
  • Partner with dealership leadership, HR Business Partners, and Corporate HR on employee engagement and retention opportunities.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 4 years of Human Resources and/or talent acquisition experience, preferably within a decentralized or multi-location organization.
  • Demonstrated success recruiting and hiring high-quality talent.
  • Experience recruiting skilled trades, technicians, transportation, logistics, supply chain, or other difficult-to-fill operational roles strongly preferred.
  • Strong sourcing, networking, and candidate pipeline development skills.
  • Ability to build credibility and influence leaders across multiple functions.
  • Proactive, results-oriented approach with a strong sense of urgency.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Experience with an ATS and HRIS; ClearCompany and UKG experience is a plus.
  • Staffing agency experience is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree and SHRM-CP, PHR, or similar certification preferred.
  • Fluency in Spanish is a plus

Why Nextran?

Nextran Truck Centers is a network of 30+ medium and heavy-duty truck dealerships committed to providing the best products and services through highly skilled employees who are focused on delivering the lowest life-cycle cost. Above all, we are dedicated to keeping our customers moving.

This role provides the opportunity to move beyond transactional recruiting and have a direct impact on Nextran's long-term talent strategy. You will help build stronger talent pipelines, develop internal bench strength, expand industry partnerships, and influence how we attract and retain great people.

If you enjoy learning the business, building relationships, finding great talent, and creating sustainable recruiting strategies, we'd like to hear from you.

Nextran Core Hiring Competencies:

  • Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions
  • Instills Trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity
  • Communicates Effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences
  • Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm
  • Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward

Join Nextran and help us build the talent that will drive our future.

Notice Regarding Job Posting Scams

We are aware that fraudulent job postings and recruitment scams are becoming more common. Please be advised that legitimate communications from our company will only come from official company email addresses and through our verified hiring platforms.

We will never ask candidates to provide payment, purchase equipment, or share sensitive personal or financial information (such as bank account details or Social Security numbers) during the initial application or interview process.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to represent our company, please do not respond or provide any information. Instead, report the communication to us through our official website or apply directly through our verified job postings.

Your safety and privacy are important to us, and we encourage all applicants to remain vigilant when searching for employment opportunities.

EEO Employer

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Specialist
jobs.description_html:
Job Title: Accounts Payable Specialist

Classification: Hourly/Non-Exempt

Reports to: Controller

Department: Accounting

Introduction:

  • The role of the Accounts Payable Specialist is to collect, report, and process all Vendor invoices and pay applications from subcontractors. He/she is to assure accountability, accuracy, and confidentiality of any and all payables related information and to track pay applications, invoices, purchase order receivers and unvouchered liabilities.

Functional Role:

  • The basic function of this position is to manage the smooth flow of Accounts Payable information of the company. To track all invoices and pay applications received and match all purchase order receivers to the appropriate invoices. They are also responsible for coordinating the approval of all subcontractors pay applications with the appropriate Project Manager and to ensure pay applications are posted to accounts payable in the accounting period that they apply to.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for maintaining Insurance certificates for subcontractors ensuring all insurance requirements are at the minimum amounts required by the subcontract and are current with respect to policy expiration dates.
  • Responsible for accurate accounting records of the Company’s Accounts Payable and Vendor records.
  • Maintain the close security of company Accounts Payable and Vendor records.
  • Maintain the confidentiality of company Accounts Payable and Vendor records.
  • Keep management apprised of the collection status of past due accounts and lien position within the time requirements that protect all lien rights.
  • Ensure the Accounts Payable documents are processed in a timely and error-free manner.

Requirements:

  • Education: High School diploma with courses in accounting.
  • Experience: Two to five year’s experience in Accounts Payable and AIA Schedule of Values.
  • MUST have lien law knowledge and experience.
  • Skills, knowledge, and abilities - Ability to work independently and to work well with others in a multi-functional fast paced environment. Good comprehension of Accounts Payables, Subcontractor and spreadsheet software, excellent reading, writing and verbal skills. Must understand AIA Schedule Of Values.
  • Reasoning Ability – Ability to apply principles of logical thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems, ability to deal with a variety of abstract and concrete variables, ability to manage a variety of activities simultaneously.
  • Language Skills – Ability to communicate and give answers in a clear and precise style, ability to compose standard letters with proper format, grammar, punctuation, and spelling, using all parts of speech, ability to speak with poise, voice control, and confidence, using correct English with a well modulated voice.
  • Physical – While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to talk on the phone and use a computer.
  • Work Environment - The work is normally performed in a standard office environment with usually quiet to moderate noise levels.

DFWP/EOE

jobs.title: Commercial Service Technician
jobs.description_html:
Responsibilities:

  • Present a positive image to customers, co-workers, and others at all times
  • Follow all service department and company policies and procedures
  • Adhere to all company safety policies
  • Attend training to improve HVAC industry knowledge
  • Perform preventative maintenance; identify potential issues (e.g., contactors, relay coils, over-amping devices, loads, transformers, motors)
  • Perform electrical troubleshooting; able to read various wiring diagrams (ladder, schematic, parallel, series circuits)
  • Understand all phases of line voltage (single phase, three phase, part start windings, two-speed motors, variable frequency drives)
  • Understand general fan laws: RPM, speed, how pulley or sheave changes and belt sizing affect amperage draw
  • Calculate CFM using heat rise or static pressure method
  • Understand piping systems: refrigerant, water, gas, condensate, pumps, valves (single/two-pipe systems, bypass circuits, modulating valves, circuit setters)
  • Understand water source equipment: water-cooled condensers, chillers, cooling towers, fluid coolers, basic water treatment knowledge
  • Calculate wire sizes, fuses, and circuit breakers for both low and line voltage loads
  • Install and program common DDC controls (e.g., Carrier, Trane)
  • Understand operation differences between VAV and VVT boxes
  • Identify and work with all types of thermostats: low/line voltage, standard, programmable, digital, and time clocks
  • Perform leak detection for water and refrigerant systems
  • Possess knowledge of semi-hermetic compressors (change unloaders, valves, valve plates, internal bypass plugs; diagnose mechanical and electrical failures)
  • Understand relationships between temperature, pressure, humidity, and their effects on indoor air comfort and quality
  • Understand the purpose and process of test and balance for building performance, pressure control, and comfort
  • Diagnose and repair all types of heating and cooling issues as required
  • Possess all necessary tools to complete tasks listed in the job description

Qualification:

  • Physical activities include standing, balancing, climbing stairs and ladders
  • Must be able to walk and lift 20 pounds or more as part of daily job duties
  • Requires use of upper extremities for forward and overhead reaching, pushing, pulling, and material handling
  • Requires use of torso and lower extremities for kneeling, crawling, stooping, twisting, and squatting
